Speaker: The Coach
Text: Tutorial base. Same buildings, same matches, its own save - so break whatever you like in here.

Speaker: The Coach
Text: Three things and you know this game. A team is nine regulars and three Stars. A match is a run of small duels. An Adventure is a day out for materials.

Speaker: The Coach
Text: What do you want first?

Speaker: The Keeper
Text: Every tier holds one card of each power. Tier I has a 0, a 1 and a 2. Tier II has a 1, a 2 and a 3. Tier III a 2, 3 and 4. Tier IV a 3, 4 and 5.

Speaker: The Keeper
Text: Which means nobody fields three fives. Not you, not them, not a boss. It is the one rule the whole thing leans on.

Speaker: The Keeper
Text: Your three Star Players hold one whole tier between them - one on each rung of it. Which tier depends on your class. That is why picking a class is the first thing the builder asks.

Speaker: The Keeper
Text: The numbers live in TierPowers.csv. Change them there and every screen changes with them - the builder, the pitch, the enemy side, the Adventure fight. Nothing is typed into the game twice.

Speaker: The Keeper
Text: Anything else?

Speaker: The Coach
Text: A match is rounds. Each round you are offered cards from one tier. You pick one, they pick one, the better number takes it.

Speaker: The Coach
Text: Win enough of them in a row and PLAY MAKER fires - the cut-away, the run at goal, the shot. That is where goals come from. Not from one big card.

Speaker: The Coach
Text: Escape in a match opens the sub menu: speed, AUTO, and the way out. AUTO plays it for you, which is how you watch a balance change rather than click through one.

Speaker: The Coach
Text: Play a match from the base is a friendly - a side put together on the spot at roughly your level. The league is behind the Seasons shelf and it keeps a table.

Speaker: The Coach
Text: Anything else?

Speaker: The Keeper
Text: An Adventure is a run out. Your nine jog right, things come past, the nearest of them peel off to pick them up. Then something blocks the way.

Speaker: The Keeper
Text: You point at whichever of them you want to go after - the thing itself, on the pitch, not a list. Hover one first and it tells you everything about it.

Speaker: The Keeper
Text: Then you draft one player from each tier. They pass it up the line, the move builds, and the last one shoots. Combos pay on top. So does taking your time - they are winding up while you do it.

Speaker: The Keeper
Text: Stamina is Adventure only. A player who runs out is knocked out for the rest of the run, and an empty tier doubles what they hit you for. Keep all four honest.

Speaker: The Keeper
Text: Nothing you collect is yours until you carry it home. Flee and you keep most of it. Fall over and you keep none of it.

Speaker: The Keeper
Text: Anything else?

Speaker: The Coach
Text: Go on then. Training Pitch is the middle building. Leave tutorial is up on the top row when you have had enough - your real save has not been touched by any of this.
